info.name: ManagementDashboard Dashx APIS API
dashxApis
Gets the list of dashboards in a compartment with pagination.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page on which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending. If no value is specified timeCreated is the default.

params.name: compartmentIdInSubtree
params.description: A parameter that returns all the accessible resources in the tenant. This applies only when the compartmentId denotes the root compartment and this parameter is set to true.

items.docs: Gets the list of dashboards in a compartment with pagination.  Returned properties are the summary.

info.name: Exports dashboards and their saved searches.

params.name: exportDashboardId
params.description: List of dashboardIds in plain text. The syntax is '{"dashboardIds":["dashboardId1", "dashboardId2", ...]}'. Escaping is needed when using in OCI CLI. For example, "{\"dashboardIds\":[\"ocid1.managementdashboard.oc1..dashboardId1\"]}" .

params.name: exportTags
params.description:
Indicates whether tags must be included when exporting dashboards and saved searches. If this attribute is set to true, then both defined and free-form tags are included in the response. The default is false and tag fields are empty objects in the response.
If set to true, NotAuthorizedException is returned if you do not have the permission to access tags, even if you have the permission to access dashboards and saved searches.

items.docs:
Exports an array of dashboards and their saved searches. Export is designed to work with importDashboard. 
Here's an example of how you can use CLI to export a dashboard: 
`$oci management-dashboard dashboard export --query data --export-dashboard-id "{\"dashboardIds\":[\"ocid1.managementdashboard.oc1..dashboardId1\"]}"  > dashboards.json`

info.name: Imports dashboards and their saved searches.  If the dashboard or the saved search already exists then it is updated.

params.name: overrideSameName
params.description:
By default, if a resource with the same OCID exists in the target compartment, it is updated during the import process, otherwise, a new resource is created.
However, if this attribute is set to true, then during the import process if a resource with the same displayName exists in the compartment, then it is updated even if the OCIDs are different. This is useful when importing the same resource multiple times. If the compartment and displayName remain the same, the resource is only updated and multiple copies of a resource are not created.

params.name: overrideDashboardCompartmentOcid
params.description: If this attribute is set, the dashboard resources are created or updated in the compartment specified by OCID. If this attribute is not set, the compartment specified in the JSON metadata is used.

params.name: overrideSavedSearchCompartmentOcid
params.description: If this attribute is set, the saved search resources are created or updated in the compartment specified by OCID. If this attribute is not set, the compartment specified in the JSON metadata is used.

items.docs:
Imports an array of dashboards and their saved searches.
